items.detail: Create the Playgama game card; verify uploaded build in QA Tool and real host.
Configure Bridge SaaS leaderboard and public token; test higher/lower scores, retry and two player accounts.

Replace code-generated synthesis with licensed recorded/produced compressed audio, add background music and audition on actual devices. Current bank is not compliant with the current sound requirement.
Complete and review every player-facing English string and English fallback, declare only fully verified languages.
Verify real Bridge save/reload, pause/audio and interstitial finish/failure; mocks do not establish host compliance.
Full ordinary run through stage 20 and death run in current desktop/mobile browsers; check rotation, touch, low FPS and long sessions.
Prepare final icon, cover, screenshots, RU/EN descriptions and device/orientation choices from the final approved build.
